hint.en: Which of the camera's quality levels in Camera Station to stream. Medium works well for most cameras. High can be very heavy (some cameras send 4K at over 10 Mbit/s) and may show a black screen; if that happens, choose Medium. Choose Low on slow mobile data.
How often the still picture on the device tile is updated. Example: 5. Use 0 to only update when you open the camera.
